_note: The one place for Time Keeper's identity. Every step reads it: scene captions and banners, narration, music, logo and end card, export. Change it here, not in code.
name: Time Keeper

fonts._why: Clean and modern for luxury watches, already embedded in the renderer (OFL licence): Cairo for Arabic, Inter Tight for Latin.
fonts.caption: "Cairo","Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif

captions._active: The word being spoken lights up in the brand gold (a darker gold on a light caption tag, so it stays above 4.5:1).

safe_area._why: Instagram/TikTok vertical: keep text clear of the app's top bar and bottom controls (in 720x1280 units).

narration.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, calm and natural documentary narration
narration._keep_latin: Foreign names and English words are written in Latin letters in the script and on screen, and the voice reads them as they are (as in the Gérald Genta films): the local engines skip the Latin-to-Arabic entries of pronunciation.json; the free draft voice still uses them.
narration._house_style: The news group's style (rule 9e, references/house-style.md): names written in Arabic as the news posts spell them (brand/names.json) and said in their own language (load() gives the voice the Latin); numbers on screen in English digits; plain letters on screen; the house words. A film made before it sets house_style: false.

engine_pronunciation._note: Respellings one engine needs on top of pronunciation.json, chosen by listening (Whisper) to the variants. VoxCPM2 shortens the first vowel of بانيراي and misreads the Italian bridge name.

watch_models._note: model names the story check looks for: a line that names one must show that very model, or no watch (storytelling rule 12i)

music._why: A cinematic bed that is heard: at gain_db in pauses, ducked about 8-10 dB more while the voice speaks (duck). A track is used only with its commercial licence record next to it (same name, .licence.json); otherwise there is no music. The owner's own track in the library wins; else the film picks from the whole catalogue by mood (prefer/avoid) and length, and its credit goes with the film.

duck._why: The music is heard: about 10 dB under the voice in the pauses and 18-20 dB under it while he speaks (Étienne's mix review: at -18 dB and ratio 6 it sat 40 dB under the voice and the film fell silent between sentences).
